source: The architecture components named in the owner's full-development directive (2026-10-26), mapped onto docs/taxguard-ai-canonical-architecture.md. The multipage TaxGuard AI Architecture Overview and its page-9 agent matrix are not in the repository and were not supplied in the session, so no per-agent responsibility is inferred from it.
statusRules: UNIT_VERIFIED: unit or PGlite tests; INTEGRATION_VERIFIED: disposable PostgreSQL or real-server HTTP tests; BROWSER_VERIFIED: a local synthetic browser journey drives the UI; PROVIDER_VERIFIED: the provider-emulation profile covers it.
None of these is independent release acceptance. PRODUCTION_READY is not used while staging and production are NO-GO and the underlying proposals are review-only.
BLOCKED_* entries name the blocker. Partial work behind a blocker is described in remainingGap.

components.name: Client portal input
components.remainingGap: Production cutover of the durable routers (owner-approved proposals).

components.name: Document intake with provenance
components.persistence: durable proposal 20261012270000 family; quarantine until a clean scan
components.remainingGap: A real malware-scanner provider (local fake only).

components.name: Email input
components.blocker: No email provider is commissioned; in-app messaging only.
components.remainingGap: Provider adapter, inbound parsing as untrusted evidence.

components.name: Accounting-system input
components.blocker: No accounting provider (QuickBooks, Xero) is commissioned; the sync service is in memory and refused in production.
components.remainingGap: Durable connector state and a commissioned provider.

components.name: Government portal input
components.blocker: No transcript or notice integration is authorized.
components.remainingGap: Everything.

components.name: Payments input
components.blocker: Sandbox only by design; production refuses the payment webhook (PAYMENT_PROVIDER_NOT_COMMISSIONED).
components.remainingGap: A commissioned payment provider.

components.name: Calendar and appointments input
components.remainingGap: External calendar or video provider (none commissioned); engagement scope pending the general-record policy.

components.name: Manual staff entry
components.remainingGap: Production cutover.

components.name: A00 Supervisor / Orchestrator
components.remainingGap: Coordinates only the bounded A34 review purposes; DRAFT, not commissioned. Reads the case readiness gate (review-only diagnostics proposal) for the verified tenant after coordinator authorization, records it as a root event and reports it to the reviewer; a missing gate or unexpected shape is UNAVAILABLE, never READY. Readiness never unlocks an action and every result still requires human review. A00 produces no confidence or amount, so it does not call the risk assessment. Request classification and workflow selection beyond that are unmapped.

components.name: Agent registry A00-A60
components.remainingGap: 61 identities, all DRAFT. 58 have no individually proven responsibility (UNMAPPED, denied). Per-agent permissions need the owner's agent matrix and approval.

components.name: Specialist agents A01-A60
components.blocker: Commissioning needs the per-agent responsibility matrix and human policy or regulatory approval. Standing instruction: do not activate real AI agents.
components.remainingGap: A10 and A34 have bounded compatibility only; no specialist is built or commissioned.

components.name: Controlled agent communication through governance
components.remainingGap: No peer-to-peer path exists; handoffs are only the bounded A00 to A34 and A10 routes.

components.name: ai_run record and reproducibility
components.remainingGap: Schema covers runs, evidence, transitions, verifications and authoritative actions. A governed test execution reconstructs every architecture field in one query through recorded links (policy hash via the admission decision, engagement via the case record); confidence, proposed action and review fields stay NULL until set, never invented. Exercised only by isolated synthetic fixtures, because no agent runs.

components.name: AI governance control plane (decisions, policy events)
components.remainingGap: Production uses PostgreSQL over TLS or refuses (no fallback); not deployed.

components.name: Model and prompt registries, versioning
components.remainingGap: No model or prompt is approved or active.

components.name: Tool, data and stage permissions (default deny)
components.remainingGap: Reads follow tenant, client, case and year scope and the live assignment. On the composed schema (every migration and review-only proposal, real PostgreSQL) no tool, data or stage permission is granted and every agent has an explicit DENY row for every tool action, data classification and stage. All 58 unmapped agents are refused at runtime even with ACTIVE status and every SQL grant set to ALLOW: 41 by the mapping check, 17 (signing/filing and platform-security categories, which no staff role may invoke) by the role check. Per-agent grants are owner decisions; none is proposed.

components.name: Human approval requirements and proposal review
components.remainingGap: No centralized cross-domain human approval queue UI.

components.name: AI kill switch
components.remainingGap: Activation only; lifting a stop requires an approved policy. Provider journey N covers it: the administrator engages an agent stop through the AI Emergency Stop UI with confirmation, the server records it, and the accountant has no control and is refused by the API (Block 48).

components.name: Token and cost governance
components.remainingGap: Pricing and usage reconciliation tables exist; no budget is configured and no model runs.

components.name: Agent evaluation framework
components.remainingGap: Activation gate and evaluation records exist (review-only proposal; not applied anywhere). No evaluation runner executes real agent cases, because no model is commissioned; no Control Center view of evaluations; dimension thresholds beyond per-case pass or fail are owner policy.
components.persistence: review-only proposal 20261018140000: suites, pinned runs, append-only case results; outcomes derived by the database

components.name: AI Control Center and agent detail
components.remainingGap: Read-only projections of live governance tables, with nothing operational to show. Browser journeys (suites 14, 15): commissioning readiness, 0 of 61 commissioned, and live records refused outside a governance database. No agent detail view beyond the commissioning rows.

components.name: Untrusted document and evidence boundary
components.remainingGap: Documents cannot authorize tools or prompts. Model input is counts only: injection text stored in client, document and evidence records never reaches the provider request. An approved prompt cannot displace the enforced boundary, which is always last. A 29-item reply corpus (trailing instructions, fences, look-alike and zero-width characters, tool and function calls, authority fields, prototype-pollution keys, injected codes, size) is rejected, and an injected reply leaves no output, no tool call and no authoritative action. No live model, so no adversarial model-level evaluation; certification of a live model belongs to the evaluation framework, which no agent has passed.

components.name: Evidence layer and provenance
components.remainingGap: Durable evidence-to-conclusion lineage (Block 66): conclusions link to verified evidence, calculation runs (rule set and hash), approved research (authority levels) and approved workpapers with per-link snapshots; staleness is derived and blocks submission, approval and readiness; backward and forward traces; browser journey through source replacement and re-approval. Proposals are review-only; document-level citations await an owner decision; lineage ends at the conclusion until form mapping (TAX-FORM-MAPPING) writes form lines; diagnostics and risk do not yet read conclusion staleness.

components.name: OCR, extraction, classification, validation
components.blocker: No OCR provider is commissioned; extraction fails safe rather than reporting success.
components.remainingGap: Provider adapter commissioning only. The human validation queue is browser-verified on the real server with a synthetic stand-in for the provider output: proposals are refused for a quarantined document, and each proposed field is accepted, corrected or rejected by staff in Document Review (decisions persist, cannot be repeated, and only accepted or corrected values carry a verified value). The client is refused the decision and sees no proposals or values. Stage 03 (Validate) now refuses while any proposal on a current, usable document of the engagement year is undecided (review-only proposal 20261018180000; real server, suite 03). Verified values do not yet feed form lines; that needs form mapping with evidence lineage (TAX-FORM-MAPPING).

components.name: Durable ledger, review and reconciliation
components.remainingGap: Proposals 024/030 and 20261018070000 are review-only. Owner policy: ordinary non-bookkeeper entries post without review. Phase 15 (2026-10-27): complete general-ledger reporting, exact cents and keyed retries integrated; prior-year opening balances in year-scoped reports await an owner decision.

components.name: Book-to-tax mappings, adjustments, workpapers
components.remainingGap: Proposal 029 review-only; firm categories (H07); preparer steps are API setup in the browser journey. Maker-checker for mapping, adjustment and workpaper approvals is tested over the HTTP route and in the current SQL definitions.

components.name: Tax research agent with authority citations
components.remainingGap: Review-only proposal; the tax-engine router (and so research) is development-only and refused in production. Synthetic test sources currently count as verified authority (SQL review point). No AI research agent: AI_INFERENCE citations are recorded and labelled by people, never produced by a commissioned agent, and never count as support. No correction-request state: a rejected memo is final and a new memo is opened.
components.persistence: review-only proposal 20261018150000: case-scoped memos and citations; decided memos immutable; audited

components.name: Versioned, year-aware tax rule engine
components.remainingGap: Proposals 033/036/038 review-only; no real rule content (needs professional verification of sources).

components.name: Deterministic calculation runs
components.remainingGap: Runs are pinned to rule-set id and hash, but only synthetic rule sets exist; no federal or state rule content.

components.name: Independent calculation verification
components.remainingGap: Rule-set verification cases and coverage exist; per-return variance and prior-year anomaly checks do not.

components.name: Return preparation (stage 09)
components.blocker: Stage 09 onward is blocked until a verified tax engine and approved rule content exist.
components.remainingGap: Consume approved calculations; controlled rework paths.

components.name: Deterministic form mapping with lineage
components.remainingGap: Form catalogue only. Block 66 added the lineage foundation (taxguard_tax_form_line_sources: form line → approved conclusion) and the backward trace reads it; no deterministic mapping writes it yet (Block 67).

components.name: Return diagnostics (warning vs blocking)
components.remainingGap: Case-readiness diagnostics only: no return, forms or field-level checks exist yet (stages 9-18 blocked). Calculation-run review and staleness rules are implemented but not exercised by the PostgreSQL suite (they need an approved rule set). Store, routes and the Case Workflow panel are browser-verified on the real server (run, persisted findings, reviewer-only acknowledgement of INFO and WARNING, blocking not waivable, reload, audit, 375 px). The gate function is ready for finalization steps that do not exist yet. Provider profile: on the journey-B case built through stages 01-08 with durable staff sessions, diagnostics find only the missing approved calculation and risk is BLOCKED for exactly that and the absent policy; the client is refused.
components.persistence: review-only proposal 20261018160000: governed rule table with versions, diagnostic runs and diagnostics with append-only history

components.name: Risk and materiality evaluation
components.remainingGap: No materiality policy exists: thresholds, minimum confidence and whether automated continuation is ever allowed are owner policy, so every assessment today routes to a person. A person states the amount and an unsupported-position flag in the Case Workflow panel (browser-verified); AI confidence is never accepted from a request and will come only from a governed AI run, which does not run. Prior-year variance and anomaly signals are not modelled. Provider profile: on the journey-B case built through stages 01-08 with durable staff sessions, diagnostics find only the missing approved calculation and risk is BLOCKED for exactly that and the absent policy; the client is refused.
components.persistence: review-only proposal 20261018170000: versioned materiality policies (independently approved, none seeded) and immutable case risk assessments

components.name: Reviewer and independent QC
components.remainingGap: Reviewer queue and decisions refuse in production (process-local adapter); durable reviewer discovery is Codex's package. No separate QC role or agent.

components.name: Signature, filing, government feedback (stages 10-13, 16)
components.blocker: No e-signature or e-file provider; live filing requires explicit approval.
components.remainingGap: Everything beyond the gates.

components.name: Authoritative record (durable, versioned, scoped)
components.remainingGap: Durable proposals are review-only. Production refuses every process-local authority (Blocks 39-41); no durable router is mounted in production. Block 66 tax conclusions exist only in the durable store (no process-local adapter); the tax-engine cutover now requires every proposal its routes use.

components.name: Audit ledger and security events
components.remainingGap: Only SECURITY_* rows are append-only in the plan; the full append-only proposal awaits the owner.

components.name: Monitoring, health and alerting
components.remainingGap: No log shipping or alerting; AI telemetry has nothing to report.

components.name: External integration adapters and readiness
components.remainingGap: Readiness reporting exists; providers (scanner, OCR, email, SMS, payments, e-sign, e-file, accounting) are not commissioned.

components.name: Client, tenant, engagement and year isolation
components.remainingGap: Messaging, appointment and legal general records wait on the owner's general-record policy. Phase 15 integration closed three year/authority gaps (general-ledger year guard, replay year scope, onboarding re-check after lock wait).

components.name: Responsive (375 px) and automated accessibility
components.remainingGap: Automation only; WCAG conformance needs manual assistive-technology testing.
